Double The Action With Double Dragon IV On Mobile Now!


Double Dragon IV is now available for both iOS and Android! The game by Arc System that was previously released for the PlayStation 4, PC and Switch is now playable literally in the palm of our hands! The game is free to download, playable up to the first mission. To play further, a purchase will be needed which makes sense since the game is priced for the PS4, PC and Switch. The story picks up after the elimination of the Black Warriors in Double Dragon II!
Experience all-new exhilarating action with the original old-school graphics! Use the art of Sou-Setsu-Ken to rescue the kidnapped Marian!

There are lots of extra modes, too! Cool new features fans have been waiting for! Playable enemy characters, Tower Mode, and even more!

reference_summary: Double Dragon IV, permainan klasik 'Em Up, kini tersedia untuk iOS dan Android. Permainan ini mengikuti cerita selepas kekalahan Black Warriors di Double Dragon II. Pemain boleh menggunakan gaya pertempuran Sou-Setu-Ken untuk menyelamatkan kerusi dan menghadapi watak musuh baru seperti Ninjas, Karate Masters, dan Wrestlers Sumo. Permainan ini percuma untuk dimuat turun dengan misi pertama plarayable, dengan pembelian diperlukan untuk bermain lebih lanjut. Mod tambahan, watak musuh yang boleh dimainkan, dan mod menara adalah beberapa ciri baru yang sejuk. Permainan ini sebelum ini dikeluarkan untuk PlayStation 4, PC, dan Switch.
